result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority. `RegionManagerTest` passes offline (`mvn -q -o`, no output, so no failures).

The change is one SQL query in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion`. I copied the `ORDER BY` from the sales-rep query, so it is `CASE t.priority WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 0 WHEN 'NORMAL' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, t.opened_date, t.id`. I also updated its doc comment to match. The closed-ticket and region filters are unchanged.

I didn't add a test for the priority ordering. The existing test only asserts a single ticket, so the new order is not covered by a test. The `DemoScenario` output for the region's open tickets will also appear in the new order.

I did not commit.
